description:
1st October – Flag Exchange with Rotary Club of Budva, Montenegro
On 1st October, PDG Rtn Ajay Gupta attended a meeting of Rotary Club of Budva, Montenegro, RID 2483 and exchanged flags with them. It was at an amazing restaurant which sells beer and wine and is owned by Rtn Crysta who is a very avid Rotarian. He has beautifully decorated the bar with over 200 Rotary Memorabilia. Present were President Luka Đonović, PP Peđa Milašević, Secretary Branka Čvorović and other members of the Club.
